subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfb8421266fbc930e546dc6ac90e921753bce5a2d3dc34bd246b77a4389cb1ca.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) AT - EX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51d5b8177263fb4e6dae05a802b6e355d9f73dfedcf5a4e22c93442d9114f7b6.png] 

Option 2) SL - WP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38bf809ce63172acf53d8c05267db591801b2efe1d1e49a9935fb88cbef8afa1.png] 

**Option 3) KD - OF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acd390a79045f42bc965936fd2e31fdb817ed437d735c37851e5d8878d8b7af6.png] 

Option 4) NG - RK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3075ef48e37c8882e9a06e0bc9912a65859d59bd359e1b6aa7a4d3e6948c5b2.png] 

Thus, KD - OF doesn't follow the pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
